//! Cell-native NV chip artwork and shared header geometry.
use crate::{
    app::App,
    theme::{Theme, ThemeMode},
};
use ratatui::{
    Frame,
    buffer::Cell,
    layout::Rect,
    style::{Color, Modifier},
};

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum Variant {
    Welcome,
    Compact,
    Emblem,
}
impl Variant {
    fn size(self) -> (u16, u16) {
        match self {
            Self::Welcome => (15, 7),
            Self::Compact => (11, 5),
            Self::Emblem => (11, 1),
        }
    }
}
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub(crate) struct HeaderLayout {
    pub variant: Variant,
    pub logo: Rect,
    pub metadata: Rect,
    pub history_y: u16,
}

/// body_height excludes the composer and footer, but includes the top margin.
pub(crate) fn layout(app: &App, area: Rect, body_height: u16) -> HeaderLayout {
    // Popups keep the underlying chip; the emblem is only an extreme height fallback.
    let variant = if body_height < 7 {
        Variant::Emblem
    } else if !app.entries.is_empty() || app.working || body_height < 11 {
        Variant::Compact
    } else {
        Variant::Welcome
    };
    let (width, height) = variant.size();
    let header_height = height.max(4);
    let (x, y) = (area.x.saturating_add(2), area.y.saturating_add(2));
    let text_x = x + width + 3;
    HeaderLayout {
        variant,
        logo: Rect::new(x, y, width, height),
        metadata: Rect::new(
            text_x,
            y + (header_height - 4) / 2,
            area.right().saturating_sub(2).saturating_sub(text_x),
            4,
        ),
        history_y: y + header_height + 1,
    }
}

// Hand-tuned cell grids preserve the mixed single/double junctions exactly.
const WELCOME: [&str; 7] = [
    "    │  │  │    ",
    "  ╔═╧══╧══╧═╗  ",
    "  ║ ┌─────┐ ║  ",
    "──╢ │ NV  │ ╟──",
    "  ║ └─────┘ ║  ",
    "  ╚═╤══╤══╤═╝  ",
    "    │  │  │    ",
];
const COMPACT: [&str; 5] = [
    "   │ │ │   ",
    " ╔═╧═╧═╧═╗ ",
    "─╢  NV   ╟─",
    " ╚═╤═╤═╤═╝ ",
    "   │ │ │   ",
];
const EMBLEM: [&str; 1] = ["  ─[NV]─   "];

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum Ink {
    PackageHighlight,
    Package,
    Die,
    Monogram,
}
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum Surface {
    Canvas,
    Package,
    Die,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
struct Stroke {
    glyph: char,
    ink: Ink,
    surface: Surface,
}
fn artwork(variant: Variant) -> Vec<Vec<Stroke>> {
    let rows: &[&str] = match variant {
        Variant::Welcome => &WELCOME,
        Variant::Compact => &COMPACT,
        Variant::Emblem => &EMBLEM,
    };
    rows.iter()
        .enumerate()
        .map(|(y, row)| {
            row.chars()
                .enumerate()
                .map(|(x, glyph)| {
                    let surface = match variant {
                        Variant::Welcome if (4..=10).contains(&x) && (2..=4).contains(&y) => {
                            Surface::Die
                        }
                        Variant::Welcome if (2..=12).contains(&x) && (1..=5).contains(&y) => {
                            Surface::Package
                        }
                        Variant::Compact if (3..=7).contains(&x) && y == 2 => Surface::Die,
                        Variant::Compact if (1..=9).contains(&x) && (1..=3).contains(&y) => {
                            Surface::Package
                        }
                        _ => Surface::Canvas,
                    };
                    let left = if variant == Variant::Welcome { 2 } else { 1 };
                    let bottom = if variant == Variant::Welcome { 5 } else { 3 };
                    let ink = if matches!(glyph, 'N' | 'V') {
                        Ink::Monogram
                    } else if surface == Surface::Die {
                        Ink::Die
                    } else if surface == Surface::Package && (y == 1 || (x == left && y < bottom)) {
                        Ink::PackageHighlight
                    } else {
                        Ink::Package
                    };
                    Stroke {
                        glyph,
                        ink,
                        surface,
                    }
                })
                .collect()
        })
        .collect()
}
fn ink(theme: Theme, role: Ink) -> Color {
    if !theme.color {
        Color::Reset
    } else if theme.rgb && theme.mode == ThemeMode::Dark {
        match role {
            Ink::PackageHighlight => Color::Rgb(184, 184, 184),
            Ink::Package => Color::Rgb(107, 107, 107),
            Ink::Die => Color::Rgb(118, 185, 0),
            Ink::Monogram => Color::Rgb(182, 227, 91),
        }
    } else {
        match role {
            Ink::PackageHighlight => Color::Gray,
            Ink::Package => Color::DarkGray,
            Ink::Die => Color::Green,
            Ink::Monogram => Color::LightGreen,
        }
    }
}
fn surface_color(theme: Theme, surface: Surface) -> Color {
    if !theme.color || theme.mode == ThemeMode::Terminal {
        return Color::Reset;
    }
    if theme.rgb {
        match surface {
            Surface::Canvas => Color::Rgb(0, 0, 0),
            Surface::Package => Color::Rgb(28, 28, 28),
            Surface::Die => Color::Rgb(48, 48, 48),
        }
    } else {
        match surface {
            Surface::Canvas | Surface::Package => Color::Black,
            Surface::Die => Color::DarkGray,
        }
    }
}
fn stroke_cell(stroke: Stroke, theme: Theme, ascii: bool) -> Cell {
    let glyph = if ascii {
        match stroke.glyph {
            '│' | '║' => '|',
            '─' | '═' => '-',
            '┌' | '┐' | '└' | '┘' | '╔' | '╗' | '╚' | '╝' | '╧' | '╤' | '╢' | '╟' => {
                '+'
            }
            other => other,
        }
    } else {
        stroke.glyph
    };
    let mut cell = Cell::default();
    cell.set_char(glyph)
        .set_style(theme.base())
        .set_fg(ink(theme, stroke.ink))
        .set_bg(surface_color(theme, stroke.surface));
    if stroke.ink == Ink::Monogram {
        cell.modifier.insert(Modifier::BOLD);
    }
    cell
}

pub(crate) fn render(frame: &mut Frame, rect: Rect, variant: Variant, theme: Theme, ascii: bool) {
    let visible = rect.intersection(frame.area());
    if visible.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    let cells = artwork(variant);
    for y in visible.y..visible.bottom() {
        for x in visible.x..visible.right() {
            frame.buffer_mut()[(x, y)] = stroke_cell(
                cells[(y - rect.y) as usize][(x - rect.x) as usize],
                theme,
                ascii,
            );
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::app::{Entry, EntryKind};
    use unicode_width::UnicodeWidthStr;

    #[test]
    fn header_balances_welcome_and_tracks_session_and_available_body_height() {
        let mut app = App::default();
        for (w, h) in [(120, 40), (100, 30), (80, 24), (60, 20)] {
            assert_eq!(
                layout(&app, Rect::new(0, 0, w, h), h - 4).variant,
                Variant::Welcome
            );
        }
        let area = Rect::new(0, 0, 60, 20);
        app.input
            .set("A draft keeps the welcome badge while it fits");
        assert_eq!(layout(&app, area, 11).variant, Variant::Welcome);
        assert_eq!(layout(&app, area, 10).variant, Variant::Compact);
        assert_eq!(layout(&app, area, 8).history_y, 8);
        app.entries
            .push(Entry::new(EntryKind::User, "", &["hello"]));
        assert_eq!(layout(&app, area, 16).variant, Variant::Compact);
        app.command("/model");
        assert_eq!(layout(&app, area, 16).variant, Variant::Compact);
        app.command("/clear");
        assert_eq!(layout(&app, area, 16).variant, Variant::Welcome);
    }

    #[test]
    fn mixed_package_junctions_inner_die_and_nv_have_exact_geometry() {
        for variant in [Variant::Welcome, Variant::Compact, Variant::Emblem] {
            let cells = artwork(variant);
            let (w, h) = variant.size();
            assert_eq!(cells.len(), h as usize);
            assert!(cells.iter().all(|row| row.len() == w as usize));
            let letters: Vec<_> = cells
                .iter()
                .flatten()
                .filter(|s| s.ink == Ink::Monogram)
                .map(|s| s.glyph)
                .collect();
            assert_eq!(letters, ['N', 'V']);
        }
        let w = artwork(Variant::Welcome);
        for x in [4, 7, 10] {
            assert_eq!(w[0][x].glyph, '│');
            assert_eq!(w[1][x].glyph, '╧');
            assert_eq!(w[5][x].glyph, '╤');
            assert_eq!(w[6][x].glyph, '│');
        }
        for (x, y, glyph) in [
            (2, 1, '╔'),
            (12, 1, '╗'),
            (2, 5, '╚'),
            (12, 5, '╝'),
            (2, 3, '╢'),
            (12, 3, '╟'),
        ] {
            assert_eq!(w[y][x].glyph, glyph);
            assert_eq!(
                w[y][x].ink,
                if y == 1 || (x == 2 && y < 5) {
                    Ink::PackageHighlight
                } else {
                    Ink::Package
                }
            );
        }
        for (x, y, glyph) in [(4, 2, '┌'), (10, 2, '┐'), (4, 4, '└'), (10, 4, '┘')] {
            assert_eq!(w[y][x].glyph, glyph);
            assert_eq!(w[y][x].ink, Ink::Die);
        }
        assert_eq!(w[3][5].glyph, ' ');
        assert_eq!(w[3][8].glyph, ' ');
        let c = artwork(Variant::Compact);
        for x in [3, 5, 7] {
            assert_eq!(c[0][x].glyph, '│');
            assert_eq!(c[1][x].glyph, '╧');
            assert_eq!(c[3][x].glyph, '╤');
            assert_eq!(c[4][x].glyph, '│');
        }
        assert_eq!(c[2][1].glyph, '╢');
        assert_eq!(c[2][9].glyph, '╟');
    }

    #[test]
    fn line_cells_preserve_palette_width_background_and_ascii_and_no_color_fallbacks() {
        for color in [true, false] {
            for rgb in [true, false] {
                for ascii in [true, false] {
                    for mode in [ThemeMode::Dark, ThemeMode::Terminal] {
                        let theme = Theme { color, rgb, mode };
                        for variant in [Variant::Welcome, Variant::Compact, Variant::Emblem] {
                            for stroke in artwork(variant).into_iter().flatten() {
                                let cell = stroke_cell(stroke, theme, ascii);
                                assert_eq!(UnicodeWidthStr::width(cell.symbol()), 1);
                                assert_eq!(
                                    cell.bg,
                                    if !color || mode == ThemeMode::Terminal {
                                        Color::Reset
                                    } else if rgb {
                                        match stroke.surface {
                                            Surface::Canvas => Color::Rgb(0, 0, 0),
                                            Surface::Package => Color::Rgb(28, 28, 28),
                                            Surface::Die => Color::Rgb(48, 48, 48),
                                        }
                                    } else if stroke.surface == Surface::Die {
                                        Color::DarkGray
                                    } else {
                                        Color::Black
                                    }
                                );
                                assert_eq!(
                                    cell.modifier.contains(Modifier::BOLD),
                                    stroke.ink == Ink::Monogram
                                );
                                if ascii {
                                    assert!(cell.symbol().is_ascii());
                                }
                                if !color {
                                    assert_eq!(cell.fg, Color::Reset);
                                }
                                assert!(!cell.symbol().chars().any(|ch| "█▀▄▓▒░".contains(ch)));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        let theme = Theme::default();
        assert_eq!(ink(theme, Ink::Package), Color::Rgb(107, 107, 107));
        assert_eq!(ink(theme, Ink::Die), Color::Rgb(118, 185, 0));
        assert_eq!(ink(theme, Ink::Monogram), Color::Rgb(182, 227, 91));
    }
    #[test]
    fn layered_surfaces_and_edge_highlights_are_bounded_to_the_package() {
        for (variant, package, die) in [
            (Variant::Welcome, 34, 21),
            (Variant::Compact, 22, 5),
            (Variant::Emblem, 0, 0),
        ] {
            let rows = artwork(variant);
            assert_eq!(
                rows.iter()
                    .flatten()
                    .filter(|s| s.surface == Surface::Package)
                    .count(),
                package
            );
            assert_eq!(
                rows.iter()
                    .flatten()
                    .filter(|s| s.surface == Surface::Die)
                    .count(),
                die
            );
        }
        let welcome = artwork(Variant::Welcome);
        for (x, y) in [(2, 1), (12, 1), (2, 2), (2, 3), (2, 4)] {
            assert_eq!(welcome[y][x].ink, Ink::PackageHighlight);
        }
        for (x, y) in [(2, 5), (12, 5), (12, 2), (12, 3), (12, 4)] {
            assert_eq!(welcome[y][x].ink, Ink::Package);
        }
        for (x, y) in [(4, 0), (0, 3), (14, 3), (4, 6), (1, 1), (13, 5)] {
            assert_eq!(welcome[y][x].surface, Surface::Canvas);
        }
        assert_eq!(welcome[3][6].surface, Surface::Die);
        assert_eq!(artwork(Variant::Compact)[2][4].surface, Surface::Die);
        assert_eq!(
            ink(Theme::default(), Ink::PackageHighlight),
            Color::Rgb(184, 184, 184)
        );
    }
}
